e2e edits a card's editor in one input, so a key can't drop under a busy page (rich-unfiled-791c.m6cg)

The flake this ticket saw was not a timeout under load. Playwright's
keyboard.type sends a key every 2-3 ms; with the card's example animating,
CodeMirror lost one about 1 run in 40 (setTimeout became setTimout). Code put
into an editor now goes through keyboard.insertText, as the demos, try-it,
playground and effects-playground specs already do. Keystroke tests keep
keyboard.type.
